disclaimer: Every dollar figure in this file is an example configuration value for the demo. It is not a quote from any model provider and not a claim about what a task will cost. Local electricity and hardware are not priced.
note: Spent and projected figures use configs/prices.yaml. They are example configuration values, not invoices.

scenarios.title: Normal task
scenarios.what: A short facilities note finishes on the frontier tier, under the soft budget.

scenarios.title: Runaway loop
scenarios.what: The model calls search_inventory with the same arguments until the repeat limit opens the breaker.

scenarios.title: Budget overrun
scenarios.what: A synthetic usage dump lands in the prompt. The next call is projected over the $0.50 hard cap and is not sent.

scenarios.title: Provider outage
scenarios.what: The frontier provider returns HTTP 503. The task finishes on the local tier.
